crossRefs.note: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
“As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.
For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to…
But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead…
For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.
translations.bsb: For we who are alive are always consigned to death for Jesus’ sake, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our mortal body.
translations.kjv: For we which live are ➔ alway delivered unto death for ➔ Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
translations.asv: For we who live are always delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus may be manifested in our mortal flesh.
